div.head: Becwæð 3.2
div.ab: Do, swa ic lære: beo ðe be ðinum 7 læt me be minum; ne gyrne ic ðines, ne læðes ne landes, ne sace ne socne; ne ðu mines ne ðearft, ne mynte ic ðe nan ðing.
Do, swa ic lære: beo ðe be þinum 7 læt [m]e be minum; ne gyrne ic ðines, ne læðes ne landes, ne sace ne socne; ne ðu mines ne ðærft, ne mynte ic ðe nan ðing.
Do as I instruct: you may stay with yours and leave me with mine: I do not grudge what is yours, lathe or landsake or soke; you have no need for mine, nor you I devise you anything.
Do as I instruct: you may stay with yours and leave me with mine: I do not grudge what is yours, lathe or landsake or soke; you have no need for mine, nor you I devise you anything.

Handle wie ich ermahne: bleibe dir bei Deinem und lass mich bei Meinem; ich begehre nicht das Deine, weder Gaubezirk noch Land, noch Gerichtsbarkeit; noch bedarfst du des Meinen, noch denk ich dir etwas zu.

Do as I counsel: keep to what is yours and leave me to what is mine; I do not desire what is yours, neither lathe nor land, nor sake nor soke [jurisdiction]; nor do you need what is mine, nor do I intend anything for you.
div.note: ‘sace ne socne’ (process and inquiry) is an alliterating pair, already a single concept. B's ‘sace’ is corrected from ‘sacene’; H reads ‘ðærft’, B's ‘ðearft’ is better. In B II Atr follows; in H the rest of the page is blank.
